title: +480 in 180 Seconds! BEST IRON Farm in Minecraft 1.21/26.2+
description: In this tutorial, I’ll show you the easiest and simplest iron farm ever made for Minecraft. This iron farm can be made in just 3 minutes, and it costs almost nothing, USING A NEW TECH that is based on a simple mechanic in the game that uses the spawning range of the villages in Minecraft to force iron golems to spawn at an exact point we like to be. This makes the farm cheaper because it doesn't need pathfinding, and it gives accurate timing, making it the best iron farm ever made for Minecraft!
author: TheySix
